registered_note: Registered while the P0 batch was generating, before any P0 batch result and before any P1 run on seeds 26-28
follows: config/p0_20261102.json (same goal task, tasks, seeds, offsets; P1 runs pair with the P0 runs of the same task, seed and offset)
question: Sampling-layer guidance on the P0 goal task: with the goal information of G0 (goal visible only in the window holding it) and of G4 (4 s lookahead), does guidance during ARDY denoising reach the goals, at what kinematic cost, compared with native conditioning (G0, G4) and output-layer correction (W0g, G4W)

observed: x_t guidance through the CFG denoiser (DPS-style), scale 1-1000: goal error equal to G0 (fraction toward the goal -0.05 to 0.14); the gradient norm on x_t is 5e-5 to 9e-4 of the gradient norm on the clean prediction at every step

Clean-prediction guidance, full step: after each edit the next clean prediction returns to the unguided goal error (0.4995-0.5000 m at 0.5 m offset, all 10 steps), so only the last-step edit survives; goal error 0, 0.1 s jerk 16-49x G0
Clean-prediction guidance at partial steps 0.2/0.5: goals partly reached, later goals diverge up to 2.5 m
With 4 s lookahead the full-step clean-prediction guidance removes the 5-18 mm residual of G4 with jerk as G4

cluster_unit: task (G = 24); seeds and offsets are paired repetitions within a task
pairing: Same task, seed and offset as the P0 runs; P1 arm order randomized within each task-seed block with Random(1000*(700+task)+seed)

S0.role: G0 plus x_t guidance (DPS-style, gradient through the CFG denoiser) at every denoising step of each goal window

X0.role: G0 plus clean-prediction guidance (OmniControl-style) at every denoising step of each goal window

V0.role: clean-prediction guidance only, no native goal constraint

X4.role: G4 plus clean-prediction guidance at each goal window (G4W counterpart)

comparators: P0 arms G0, G4, W0g, G4W of the same task, seed and offset (config/p0_20261102.json)

primary.family: Four hypotheses, Holm-adjusted at 0.05 over exact sign-flip p values; each also requires its interval on the stated side. One value per run (mean over the 4 goals for goal error), pooled over both offsets, equal-weight task means of paired differences
primary.L1: x_t guidance has no leverage: S0 - G0 goal error equivalent to 0 within +-0.05 m (two shifted one-sided tests, p = the larger; interval inside +-0.05)
primary.L2: X0 - G0 jerk at the 0.1 s step > 0, with the X0 cell mean goal error <= 0.05 m at each offset
primary.L3: X0 - W0g jerk at the 0.1 s step differs from 0 (two-sided; the sign is reported)
primary.L4: X4 - G4 jerk at the 0.1 s step non-inferior with margin +10% of the pooled G4 mean: test of (difference - margin) < 0
primary.decision: L1 and L2 together support 'in ARDY, sampling-layer guidance either has no leverage (x_t) or acts as a last-step replacement with a jerk cost (clean prediction)'; L3 places that cost against output-layer correction; L4 asks whether guidance is free once lookahead conditioning has done the work

secondary: Mechanism: per S0 run, the ratio of x_t to clean-prediction gradient norms over the 10 steps of the first goal window; per X0 run, the pre-edit goal error of each step relative to the unguided error (erasure)
V0 - X0 on every metric: whether the native in-window constraint changes the guided result
Goal error, goal success <= 0.05 m, boundary jerk, foot sliding, trunk inclination for every arm and comparator; per-offset cells; X4 - G4W
A later OpenSim evaluation (residual force) of X0 and X4 is a separate registration

inference.primary: Equal-weight task means of paired differences; cluster t interval with G-1 degrees of freedom and exact sign-flip p

grid: 4 arms x 2 offsets x 24 tasks x 3 seeds
estimated_hours: about 2 on two GPUs (about 22 s per run)

pilot.jobs: Offset task 10, seed 26, every arm and offset (8 runs); reused by the batch
pilot.admission: Finite complete outputs; time within 3x a 25 s estimate; 4 goal receipts at 4/8/12/16 s; one reference run; exactly 4 guided windows and 40 guided steps; each arm identical to its P0 base run (G0 for S0/X0/V0, G4 for X4) before the first goal window (joints, 1e-6 m)

conventions_not_derived: x_t guidance scale 100 (development grid 1-1000 had no effect on the goal); clean-prediction step 1 (full step; partial steps diverged in development); one guidance iteration per denoising step; jerk non-inferiority margin 10% of the G4 mean
